summary: Implements binary search and numeric sorting logic for searching an item in a sorted array.
purpose: Provides a binary search algorithm to efficiently locate a value within a sorted array using recursion, and includes a numeric sorting comparator.

workflows.name: Binary Search Workflow
steps: Accept searchItem, startPos, endPos, and arr as input.
Check if startPos == endPos. If true, compare searchItem and arr[startPos]. If equal, return startPos; else, return -1.
If startPos > endPos, return -1 (search not found).
If arr[midPoint] equals searchItem, return midPoint.
If searchItem < arr[midPoint], recursively search the left half (startPos to midPoint-1).
If searchItem > arr[midPoint], recursively search the right half (midPoint+1 to endPos).

workflows.name: Numeric Sorting Workflow
steps: Accept two numbers, e1 and e2.
Return e1 - e2 for numeric sorting comparator.

business_rules: Binary search operates only on sorted arrays.
If item is not found, function returns -1.
validations: Ensure array is sorted numerically before searching.
Check valid range for startPos and endPos.
conditions: startPos == endPos: Only one element remains.
searchItem == arr[startPos] or arr[midPoint]: Item found.
startPos > endPos: Search terminates, item not found.
system_behavior: Search fails if array is not sorted.
BinarySearch returns index if found, -1 if not found.
dependencies: Requires numeric_sort for sorting arrays prior to search.
exceptions: If startPos > endPos, function returns -1 indicating item not found.
content_gaps: No explicit error handling for invalid input types.
